invariants.rationale: This directly reflects the core logic of the computePrice method.
If quantity and unit price are both non-negative, the result should also be non-negative.
If quantity is zero, result is zero; otherwise, price is at least as large as one unit price.
If unit price is zero, total is zero; otherwise, result is at least quantity for unitPrice >= 1.
Method uses order methods/fields, so a non-null order is required for correct execution.
